name: MatchID
description: identifier for the match

name: MatchRA
description: right ascension coordinate of the match position

name: MatchDec
description: declination coordinate of the match position

name: DSigma
description: standard deviation of source positions in match

name: AbsCorr
description: indicator of whether the match contains sources that are aligned to a standard catalog

name: NumFilters
description: number of filters in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

name: NumVisits
description: number of visits in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

name: NumImages
description: number of Hubble Legacy Archive single filter, visit-combined (level 2) images in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

name: StartTime
description: earliest start time of exposures in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

name: StopTime
description: latest stop time of exposures in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

name: StartMJD
description: modified Julian date (MJD) for earliest start time of exposures in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

name: StopMJD
description: modified Julian date (MJD) for latest stop time of exposures in match with sources detected in the aper2 aperture

name: TargetName
description: name of a target for an exposure in match

name: CI
description: average normalized concentration index for sources detected in the aper2 aperture within the match

name: CI_Sigma
description: standard deviation of normalized concentration index values for sources detected in the aper2 aperture within the match

name: KronRadius
description: average Kron radius for sources detected in the aper2 aperture within the match

name: KronRadius_Sigma
description: standard deviation of Kron radius values for sources detected in the aper2 aperture within the match

name: Extinction
description: extinction, obtained from the NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), along the line of sight to the match position

name: SpectrumFlag
description: Y/N indicator of whether there is a spectrum in the Hubble Legacy Archive for this match. If the value is Y, then there is an entry in table SpecCat for the match.
